title: Sr Exec - Payroll & Compliance
description:
* Manage end\-to\-end payroll processing for operations staff, including attendance, shifts, overtime, incentives and deductions.
* Ensure timely and accurate salary processing while maintaining payroll records and employee databases.
* Handle statutory compliances including PF, ESIC, PT, TDS, Labour Laws and applicable Shops \& Establishments regulations.
* Prepare and file monthly/periodic statutory returns and ensure timely payment of statutory dues.
* Coordinate with HR, Finance and operations teams for attendance, payroll inputs, joining/exit formalities and employee documentation.
* Maintain employee records, wage registers, compliance registers and documentation required for audits and inspections.
* Coordinate with government authorities, auditors and consultants on labour and statutory compliance matters.
* Ensure compliance with employment, access, documentation and operational requirements, while supporting smooth HR/payroll operations.


**Requirements**
 Min graduation
   

  

 Must have managed payroll for a min of 500\+ Employee strength
